Zoe (Marketing): Quick thread  idea: run 'Lightning Labs + Office Hours' instead of long breakouts. 30m of 6x5m lightning stations then 20m of office hours with rotating experts. Keeps producer load lower and increases 1:1 follow-ups.
Rafael (Host): Love it. 6 stations at 5m each is tight but doable. We'll ask attendees to pick 2 stations in advance so we can route follow-ups.
Pri (Growth): Good for lead scoring. Map station picks to HubSpot fields and tag for post-event sales outreach. Also gate the downloadable benchmark script behind the CTA.
Ibrahim (Product): Product can run 2 stations: 'profiling hotspots' and 'autoscale policies'. Casey can take 'batching & quant' and a short demo.
Casey (Eng): I'll prepare 2x30s recorded gifs plus one live CLI snippet as fallback. Need rehearsal GPU for live tests. Example snippet: `./bench --model=redwood-small --batch=64 --quant=int8`.
Maya (Speaker Ops): Speakers: submit 3 bullet talking points + 30s gif by Tue EOD. I'll compile greenroom notes and timing cues.
Zoe (Marketing): Draft run-of-show (PT):
```
09:30 - Welcome + agenda (Rafael) - 3m
09:33 - Framing: what we'll cover and how to pick stations - 4m
09:37 - Lightning Stations (6 x 5m auto-advance) - 30m
10:07 - Office Hours panels (3 concurrent 6m panels) - 18m
10:25 - Regroup + seeded 7m Q&A - 7m
10:32 - CTA + gated assets + next steps - 3m
```
Rafael (Host): Can we trim station count to 5 if we need more QA time? Keep flexible.
Pri (Growth): We'll run a pre-event poll to capture primary pain (cost/latency/accuracy) and pre-assign 2 stations to each attendee based on that. Map to HubSpot prop accordingly.
SupportBot: rehearsal env provisioned: rwdw-lightning-176555. Recording endpoints enabled.
Casey (Eng): Backup plan: I'll produce a 2-min compiled demo that can be streamed if live nodes glitch.
Maya (Speaker Ops): Action items: 1) speakers -> bullets + gif (Tue EOD); 2) Casey -> live+fallback (done); 3) Pri -> HubSpot mapping & pre-poll; 4) Rafael -> host script; 5) Zoe -> landing page copy + gated CTA. Rehearsals: tech check = 1765620000, full dress = 1765706400.
Zoe (Marketing): Promo blurb: "Lightning Labs: six 5-minute hands-on wins to cut inference cost and latency + 1:1 office hours." CTA: "Reserve and pick your stations".
Pri (Growth): Also plan a timed social push with a micro-benchmark stat 24h before.
Rafael (Host): I'll prep transition lines to keep stations on schedule and collect the top office-hours questions to seed the final Q&A.
Zoe (Marketing): Nice. Locking format unless objections. :white_check_mark:
